description: A PERFORM varying-phrase (the VARYING phrase or an AFTER phrase) with its BY phrase omitted (ISO §2023:14.9.28.4 GR12: 'For any BY phrase that is omitted, the augment value is 1'). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985's Format 4 (§1985:VI.6.21.2) prints `BY {identifier-4 | literal-2}` and `BY {identifier-7 | literal-4}` unbracketed, and its rules know no default augment: §1985:VI.6.21.4 GR10d, 'The value of the data item referenced by identifier-2 is augmented by the specified increment or decrement value (literal-2 or the value of the data item referenced by identifier-4)', and §1985:VI.6.21.4 GR1, 'The data items referenced by identifier-4 and identifier-7 must not have a zero value'; §2002:14.8.27.3 GR9 adds 'For any BY phrase that is omitted, the augment value is 1', so the omission is legal 2002 source; §2014:14.9.27.3 GR9 carries the same sentence, so 2014 = 2023. §2002:F.2's PERFORM VARYING item (item 93: 'The BY value may be 0, the FROM value is not required to correspond to a table element...') does not name the omission; the two texts' formats and rules are the evidence. GnuCOBOL 3.2 agrees (it refuses the omission at -std=cobol85, 'PERFORM VARYING without BY phrase does not conform to COBOL 85', and accepts it at cobol2002 and later), a corroboration only. Gated in ONE place per site, VersionConformancePass.VisitPerformVarying and VisitPerformVaryingAfter, at the phrase that omits BY (kb/Work PB2282).
display: a PERFORM VARYING or AFTER phrase with the BY phrase omitted
vcr: PERFORM varying-phrase BY optional (2002; quoted from the 1985, 2002 and 2014 texts); VCR row 7.42

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMPVBY.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 N PIC 9(2).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM VARYING N FROM 1 UNTIL N > 2
        DISPLAY N
    END-PERFORM.
    STOP RUN.
